name: e-Shram
full_name: e-Shram Portal (National Database of Unorganised Workers)
benefit: Free registration gives a 12-digit Universal Account Number (UAN) e-Shram card and one-stop access to welfare schemes like PM-SYM pension, PMSBY and PMJJBY insurance, ration portability (ONORC) and job/skilling portals.
eligibility: Age 16 years or above
Works in the unorganised sector: gig/platform worker, street vendor, domestic, construction, agricultural, migrant, home-based or self-employed worker
Organised-sector workers also qualify if not in EPFO/ESIC and not a government employee
exclusions: Income tax payers
Members of EPFO or ESIC
Government employees
how_to_apply: Self-register free on the e-Shram portal with Aadhaar OTP, or visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) / State Seva Kendra. No fee is charged.

name: PM-SYM
benefit: Assured pension of Rs 3,000 per month after age 60; you pay Rs 55 to Rs 200 per month (by joining age) and the Central Government adds an equal amount. Spouse gets 50% as family pension after the subscriber's death.
eligibility: Unorganised worker aged 18 to 40 at entry
Monthly income Rs 15,000 or less
Has a savings bank or Jan Dhan account and a mobile phone
exclusions: Income tax payers
Organised-sector workers
Members of EPFO, NPS or ESIC
how_to_apply: Visit the nearest CSC, pay the first contribution in cash and sign the auto-debit mandate to get a Shram Yogi card; or self-register on maandhan.in or via the e-Shram portal. Helpline 1800 267 6888.

name: PMJJBY
full_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
benefit: Life insurance of Rs 2 lakh to the nominee on death due to any cause, for a premium of Rs 436 per year auto-debited from your bank/post office account (cover year 1 June to 31 May).
eligibility: Age 18 to 50 years
Has an individual bank or post office savings account
Gives consent for auto-debit
exclusions: Can join through only one bank/post office account
Cover ends at age 55
30-day lien (waiting) period from enrolment
Cover lapses if account is closed or has insufficient balance on renewal
how_to_apply: Submit the consent-cum-declaration form at your bank branch or post office, or enrol through net banking. Late joiners pay a reduced pro-rata premium (Rs 342 / 228 / 114 by quarter).

name: PMSBY
benefit: Accident insurance for Rs 20 per year: Rs 2 lakh on accidental death or total permanent disability, Rs 1 lakh on partial permanent disability (loss of one eye, hand or foot).
eligibility: Age 18 to 70 years
Has an individual bank or post office savings account
Gives consent for auto-debit
exclusions: Can join through only one bank/post office account
Cover ends at age 70
Cover lapses if account is closed or has insufficient balance on renewal
how_to_apply: Submit the enrolment form at your bank branch or post office, or enrol through net banking; premium is auto-debited each year around 1 June. Toll-free 1800-180-1111 / 1800-110-001.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
benefit: Guaranteed pension of Rs 1,000, 2,000, 3,000, 4,000 or 5,000 per month from age 60 (you choose), then the same pension to the spouse, and the saved corpus to the nominee after both die.
eligibility: Age 18 to 40 years at joining
Has a bank or post office savings account
Contributes monthly, quarterly or half-yearly by auto-debit until age 60
exclusions: Anyone who is or has been an income tax payer (from 1 Oct 2022)
documents: Bank / post office savings account (KYC taken from it)
how_to_apply: Submit the APY form at your bank branch or post office, or join online via net banking or the eNPS/e-APY portal. Helpline 1800-110-069.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
full_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (incl. Ayushman Vay Vandana for 70+)
benefit: Free cashless hospital treatment up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year at empanelled government and private hospitals across India; pre-existing diseases covered from day one. All seniors aged 70+ get their own Rs 5 lakh cover (Vay Vandana card) regardless of income.
eligibility: Families listed under SECC 2011 deprivation criteria, e.g. landless manual-labour households, SC/ST households, kutcha one-room houses, no adult earning member

Urban workers in listed occupations: ragpicker, domestic worker, street vendor, construction worker, sanitation worker, home-based worker, driver/transport worker, shop/delivery helper, electrician/mechanic, washerman/chowkidar
Any senior citizen aged 70 or above, irrespective of income (Ayushman Vay Vandana card)
No limit on family size or age
exclusions: Non-70+ households owning a motor vehicle, mechanised farm equipment, a pucca house, or 5+ acres of land
Non-70+ households with a government employee or a member earning above Rs 10,000/month
Seniors under CGHS, ECHS or CAPF must choose either that scheme or PM-JAY
how_to_apply: Check eligibility and get the Ayushman card at a CSC or empanelled hospital (Arogya Mitra), or online via the PM-JAY portal / UMANG. Seniors 70+ can enrol for the Vay Vandana card the same way using Aadhaar.

name: PM-KISAN
benefit: Rs 6,000 per year to each eligible farmer family, paid as three instalments of Rs 2,000 directly into the Aadhaar-seeded bank account (23rd instalment released June 2026).
eligibility: Landholding farmer family with cultivable land in their name
e-KYC completed and Aadhaar-seeded bank account
exclusions: Institutional landholders
Families with a current/former constitutional post holder, minister, MP, MLA, MLC, mayor or district panchayat chairperson
Serving/retired government or PSU employees (except Group D/MTS)
Pensioners getting Rs 10,000+ per month (except Group D/MTS)
Anyone who paid income tax in the last assessment year
Practising doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs and architects
how_to_apply: Register on pmkisan.gov.in via 'New Farmer Registration' with Aadhaar OTP, or at the nearest CSC; complete e-KYC. Check status on the portal's Beneficiary Status page.

name: Widow Pension (IGNWPS)
full_name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (NSAP)
benefit: Central pension of Rs 300 per month for widows aged 40-79 and Rs 500 per month from age 80, paid by DBT; states add their own top-up, so the actual amount varies by state.
eligibility: Widow aged 40 years or above
Belongs to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household
exclusions: Pension stops on remarriage
Pension stops if the household moves above the poverty line
how_to_apply: Apply at the Gram Panchayat or Block office (rural) or Municipality (urban); applications are verified and sanctioned locally. Online application is also possible via UMANG (search NSAP).

name: Old Age Pension (IGNOAPS)
full_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (NSAP)
benefit: Central pension of Rs 200 per month for ages 60-79 and Rs 500 per month from age 80, paid by DBT; states add a top-up, so actual pensions vary by state.
eligibility: Age 60 years or above
Belongs to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household
Indian citizen
how_to_apply: Apply at the Gram Panchayat or Block office (rural) or Municipality (urban), or online via UMANG (search NSAP).

name: PM SVANidhi
benefit: Collateral-free working capital loans for street vendors: Rs 15,000, then Rs 25,000, then Rs 50,000 on timely repayment, with 7% yearly interest subsidy, digital-payment cashback up to Rs 1,600, and a UPI RuPay credit card (up to Rs 30,000) after repaying the 2nd loan. Lending open till March 2030.
eligibility: Street vendor in an urban area (vegetables, fruits, street food, barber, cobbler, laundry etc.)
Has a Certificate of Vending / ID card from the Urban Local Body, or was identified in the ULB survey
Or has a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from the ULB / Town Vending Committee, including peri-urban/rural vendors selling within city limits
exclusions: Next loan only after timely repayment of the previous one
Interest subsidy only on standard (non-NPA) loan accounts
documents: Certificate of Vending / ID card or Letter of Recommendation
Voter ID / Driving licence / MGNREGA card / PAN
how_to_apply: Apply on the PM SVANidhi portal or mobile app with Aadhaar-linked mobile OTP, or with help from your Urban Local Body / CSC. Toll-free 1800111979.
